items.title: Mat Domber interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: we have James Chirillo and Howard Alden, two guitars, no piano.

ctx.x: Well in this record that I mentioned, that will be coming out soon, which will be called “Dialogues” with Ken Peplowski, we have James Chirillo and Howard Alden, two guitars, no piano. Two guitars, bass and drums.

Returning to your label for a second, the brochure says classic jazz lives on. Did you have a discussion about what exactly are we going to put there. I mean you did not put traditional jazz lives on, you didn’t put just jazz lives on. Was that a sort of a big decision?
